---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or enhancement
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Problem It Solves
What problem does this feature address? Why is it needed?

## Proposed Solution
How would you like this feature to work?

## Alternative Solutions
Have you considered any alternative approaches?

## Examples
Provide examples, mockups, or references to similar implementations:
- Screenshots
- Drawings
- Links to similar features

## Use Cases
Who would benefit from this feature and how?

1. Use case 1: ...
2. Use case 2: ...

## Implementation Considerations
- **Complexity**: [Simple / Medium / Complex]
- **Performance Impact**: [None / Low / Medium / High]
- **Breaking Changes**: [Yes / No]

## Additional Context
Any other information about the feature request.

## Would you like to implement this?
- [ ] Yes, I'd like to work on this
- [ ] No, just suggesting
- [ ] Need guidance on how to implement
